_comment: Strings the app needs that the design prototype did not include: error copy, auth failures and generic actions. Design-derived strings live in design/extracted/strings.json and are never edited by hand.

errorOffline.en: No connection. Check your network and try again.
errorOffline.am: ግንኙነት የለም። አውታረ መረብዎን አረጋግጠው እንደገና ይሞክሩ።

errorServer.en: Something went wrong on our side.

errorPermission.en: You do not have permission to do that.

errorTimeout.en: That took too long. Try again.

authErrorInvalidEmail.en: That email address is not valid.

authErrorInvalidCredentials.am: ኢሜይል ወይም የይለፍ ቃል ትክክል አይደለም።

authErrorEmailInUse.en: An account already uses that email.

authErrorOperationNotAllowed.en: That sign-in method is not enabled.

authErrorRequiresRecentLogin.en: Please sign in again to continue.

authErrorTooManyRequests.en: Too many attempts. Try again shortly.
authErrorTooManyRequests.am: በጣም ብዙ ሙከራዎች። ትንሽ ቆይተው ይሞክሩ።

authErrorAccountExistsDifferentCredentia.en: You already signed up with a different method.

authErrorCredentialInUse.en: Those credentials belong to another account.

authErrorGeneric.en: We could not sign you in.

authErrorSignedOut.en: You are signed out. Sign in to continue.
